newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-MINOR LEAGUE CLUB SPRING CUP SURPRISE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MINOR LEAGUE CLUB SPRING CUP SURPRISE.

text.p: Minor league Hednesford achieved a shock 1-0 F.A. Cup third round win over English second division side York on Monday.
A 43rd minute penalty by Keith Russell gave Hednesford a lucrative fourth round match with premier league Middlesbrough in two weeks.
York always struggled after midfielder Gary Himsworth was sent off after giving away the spot kick when he handled Paul Carty's shot on the goal line.
